locator.title: Как сейчас говорить с аудиторией, чтобы у вас покупали
locator.lead: Разбираем, как удержать внимание, вызвать доверие и подвести человека к покупке

current_heading.text: Начинайте с боли читателя, а не с продукта

nearest_text_before.text: Человек, который видит вашу рекламу, не ищет конкретный бренд. Он ищет решение своей задачи: как охладить маленькую квартиру, куда вложить свободные деньги, какие кроссовки выбрать для бега по асфальту.

nearest_text_after.text: В ПромоСтраницах знакомство со статьей происходит через рекламное объявление с заголовком. Пользователь видит его в РСЯ или на Поиске и решает, открыть материал или пройти мимо.

image_reading: A woman sits on a rug beside a low table, holding an open laptop and looking calmly toward the window.
Her hands rest at the laptop keyboard; the scene has soft daylight, a still room, and a relaxed focused mood.
A green bottle and blue mug are visible on the table beside her.
analysis.article_context: Cover image for an article about earning attention and trust through useful, audience-focused communication. The calm woman working with a laptop conveys an unhurried, attentive conversation rather than intrusive selling.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: Attentive, useful communication creates a calm moment in which a person chooses to engage.
structured_intent.primary_action: The woman gradually shifts her attention to the laptop and begins typing.
structured_intent.terminal_state: She is visibly focused on the laptop screen while typing.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: Her calm, receptive, thoughtful engagement remains present through the last frame.

models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, she smoothly redirects her gaze to the laptop and lets her hands begin a measured, continuous typing motion. The camera stays fixed on her and the laptop. By the final moments, her attention is clearly settled on the screen while the composed, approachable mood remains unchanged.
models.positive_prompt: The woman gently shifts her attention from the window down to her laptop and begins a calm, deliberate typing motion. Fixed camera. In the final frame she is steadily focused on the laptop, with a quiet engaged expression.

models.scene_plan: For this five-second shot, her focus travels naturally from the window to the laptop, then continues into gentle, unhurried typing that carries through most of the duration. Keep the camera fixed so the laptop remains the focal target. The final frame shows her clearly working with the screen, retaining a calm receptive expression.
models.positive_prompt: With a fixed camera, the woman gradually turns her gaze to the laptop and starts typing at an even pace. End with her calmly engaged with the screen, still composed and attentive.

models.scene_plan: In four seconds, use a concise, even transition: the woman lowers her attention to the laptop and begins a simple continuous typing motion. The fixed frame keeps her face and laptop visible throughout. Near the end, she is visibly absorbed in the screen without changing the calm, thoughtful tone.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera on the woman and laptop. She smoothly lowers her gaze to the screen and begins typing with calm purpose. The final frame shows her fully focused on the laptop with the same relaxed, attentive expression.
